main.description: A space policy: access is decided by a member list maintained by the authority.

publicRead.description: Anyone may read; no delegation token is required.

publicWrite.description: Writes from any user are tracked and forwarded, not just members'.

allowedApps.description: OAuth client IDs permitted to read, checked against the attested client_id. Does not apply to writes.

publishPolicy.description: Publish the policy to readers as a record in the authority's repo.

publishMembers.description: Publish the member list to readers as records in the authority's repo.
